## ARR 提交准备检查

### 1. Supplementary 材料确认

检查论文目录结构：
```bash
ls -la /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/main.pdf
ls -la /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/main.tex
```

读取 main.tex 确认所有 appendix 都是通过 \input 包含的：
```
Read main.tex, 搜索所有 \input 行，列出包含的 appendix 文件
```

确认是否有单独的 supplementary 文件（如 code_documentation.pdf）：
```bash
ls /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/supplementary* 2>/dev/null
ls /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/*.zip 2>/dev/null
```

### 2. 代码匿名化检查

检查远程服务器上的代码：
```bash
ssh_read_only("westd-16980", "cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie && grep -rn '@.*\.edu\|@.*\.ac\.\|@.*university\|@.*\.com' *.py scripts/*.py README* 2>/dev/null | head -20")
ssh_read_only("westd-16980", "cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie && grep -rni 'author.*=\|my name\|university of\|institute of' *.py scripts/*.py README* 2>/dev/null | head -20")
ssh_read_only("westd-16980", "cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie && grep -rn 'wandb\.\|wandb_project\|wandb_entity\|wandb\.ai' *.py scripts/*.py configs/*.py 2>/dev/null | head -20")
ssh_read_only("westd-16980", "cat /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -30")
```

也检查本地代码（如果有）：
```bash
find /home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ -name "*.py" -not -path "*/artifacts/*" | head -20
```

### 3. ARR 提交格式检查

读取 main.tex 前 50 行，检查：
- `\usepackage[review]{acl}` 或 `\usepackage[anonymous]{acl}` （匿名模式）
- `\author` 行是否为 "Anonymous ACL submission" 或类似匿名格式
- 确认没有 `\thanks{}` 或其他暴露身份的命令

检查 PDF 元数据（如果 main.pdf 存在）：
```bash
python3 -c "
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['pdfinfo', '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/main.pdf'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
" 2>/dev/null || echo "pdfinfo not available"
```

如果 pdfinfo 不可用，试：
```bash
python3 -c "
with open('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/main.pdf', 'rb') as f:
    content = f.read()
    # Search for Author in PDF metadata
    import re
    authors = re.findall(b'/Author\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)', content)
    creators = re.findall(b'/Creator\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)', content)
    producers = re.findall(b'/Producer\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)', content)
    print(f'Author metadata: {[a.decode() for a in authors]}')
    print(f'Creator: {[c.decode() for c in creators]}')
    print(f'Producer: {[p.decode() for p in producers]}')
"
```

### 产出
报告格式：
```
## 1. Supplementary
- main.pdf: 存在/不存在，页数
- appendix: 全部包含在 main.pdf 中 / 缺少 X
- 单独 supplementary: 需要/不需要

## 2. 匿名化
- 代码中发现的问题: 列表 / 无问题
- README: 安全 / 需修改
- W&B URL: 无 / 发现于 X

## 3. 格式
- review 模式: ✓/✗
- author 匿名: ✓/✗  
- PDF 元数据: 安全/需修改
```

% Runtime overhead (inline paragraph, no subsection header to save space)

\paragraph{Runtime overhead.}
\label{sec:runtime}
S1 overhead is $+$13.1\% on SciERC, lower on DocRED due to amortization over longer sequences; under LoRA, $+$10.0\% with 37\% lower absolute latency.
Constraint compilation is one-time $<$0.5\,s; scaling benchmarks confirm constant overhead (2--3\%) up to 200 entity types and 1{,}000 relations (Appendix~\ref{app:scalability}).

\paragraph{Beam search compatibility.}
\label{sec:beam-results}
% exp_id: d066_beam_sweep
With LoRA, beam search~\cite{anderson2017guided} eliminates all four violation types at 8B on both SciERC and DocRED; at 70B, beam $k{=}4$ achieves DR${=}$RV${=}$ET${=}$0\% with one residual CF on SciERC (Appendix~\ref{app:beam-search}).
A beam-width sweep ($k \in \{1,2,4,8\}$) on SciERC reveals $k{=}2$ as Pareto-optimal: R-F1 44.60 (highest), CF 0.11\%, at only 1.18$\times$ greedy S1 latency; $k{=}4$ achieves CF${=}$0\% but lower R-F1 (43.60) at 1.39$\times$ (Table~\ref{tab:beam-sweep}; latencies relative to greedy S1).
This yields three deployment tiers: greedy S1 ($+$10\% latency, DR${\leq}$0.21\%, CF${\leq}$1.4\%), beam $k{=}2$ (1.18$\times$, near-zero CF), and beam $k{=}4$ (1.39$\times$, all violations${\to}$0\% at 8B).
Per-beam memory overhead is $O(k \times |\text{entities}| \times |\text{types}|)$ for independent entity registry copies, negligible at typical document scales.

% exp_ids: r16_70b_scierc_zs_s1, r16_70b_docred_zs_s1, 70b_lora_scierc, 70b_lora_docred_200
\paragraph{70B-class validation (single-family).}
\label{sec:70b-results}
The following results constitute a preliminary single-family scale exploration on Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (AWQ INT4); cross-family verification (e.g., Qwen-72B) remains future work.
All 70B experiments use Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct under AWQ INT4 quantization; an 8B ablation confirms constraint enforcement is unaffected by quantization (Appendix~\ref{app:quantization}).
Zero-shot S1 eliminates DR on both datasets (SciERC 6.41\%\,$\to$\,0\%, DocRED 14.98\%\,$\to$\,0\%; R-F1 11--13).
% exp_ids: r16_70b_scierc_zs_ablation (grammar_only, semantic_only, full_s1)
A four-way ablation reveals scale-dependent layer interaction: semantic-only achieves 84\% DR reduction vs.\ 8B's 24\% (Table~\ref{tab:scierc-ablation}), though grammar remains necessary for RV elimination and CF control (semantic-only CF${=}$76).
% exp_ids: eval_70b_lora_scierc_s1_constrained, eval_70b_lora_docred_200_s1_constrained
LoRA confirms composability: DR\,$\to$\,0\% on both datasets (R-F1 44.53, 43.95; $|\Delta| \leq 0.20$\,pp; CF 0.18--1.33\%); cross-family generalization at 70B scale remains to be verified.
% exp_ids: eval_70b_lora_docred_200_beam4_s1
Beam ($k{=}4$) reduces DocRED parse failures (12.5\%\,$\to$\,0.5\%, R-F1 $+$4.19\,pp); SciERC controlled comparison isolates pure beam gain at $+$0.28\,pp (Appendix~\ref{app:70b-ablation}).

% exp_ids: trie_qwen_ft_scierc, trie_qwen_zs_scierc, trie_llama_ft_scierc, trie_llama_zs_scierc
\paragraph{Comparison with grammar-constrained approaches.}
\label{sec:constrained-baselines}
Our grammar-only ablation (Table~\ref{tab:scierc-ablation}, row~2) implements the same constraints as GCD~\cite{geng2023gcd} and BoostCD~\cite{boostcd2025}; vLLM \texttt{guided\_json}~\cite{kwon2023vllm} confirms equivalence on Qwen3-8B (DR${=}$15.26\%; other models use the same backend; Appendix~\ref{app:gcd-comparison}).
The ${\sim}$15\% residual DR is the gap our semantic layer addresses (94\% total reduction); trie-only constraints without JSON enforcement yield 9--51\% parse failure (Appendix~\ref{app:trie-baseline}).

\begin{abstract}
Large language models for information extraction generate structurally valid but ontologically invalid triples---where entity types violate the ontology's domain/range constraints.
These violations persist across the capability spectrum and cannot be addressed by grammar-constrained decoding (which lacks cross-field type awareness) or post-hoc filtering (which discards valid predictions).

We present \textsc{OntoCoDec}, a framework that compiles information extraction ontologies into composable token-level decoding constraints.
A decidability analysis shows that domain/range constraints exceed context-free expressiveness, yielding a two-layer architecture: a grammar layer enforces structural validity and vocabulary membership; a semantic layer enforces type constraints at runtime through stateful masking over a dynamic entity registry.

% exp_ids: w5_lora_scierc_constrained_eval, w5_qwen_docred_lora_constrained_eval, w5_llama_lora_scierc_constrained_eval, w5_llama_docred_lora_constrained_eval
Evaluated across three 8B-class models and two relation extraction datasets (up to 96 relations), OntoCoDec composed with LoRA fine-tuning reduces domain/range violations to $\leq$\,0.21\% at F1 40--46\%, converting irrecoverable type errors to correctable cross-field inconsistencies (CF\,$\leq$\,1.4\%); beam search ($k{=}4$) eliminates all violation types at 1.39$\times$ latency.
In zero-shot settings, DR reductions span 76--99\% on SciERC and 42--90\% on DocRED; CF increases are concentrated in hallucinated entities (58.1\%) and decrease with scale and fine-tuning.
\end{abstract}

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

CF direction depends on calibration: S1 introduces CF for calibrated models (up to 12.02\%) but reduces it for Mistral (56.87\%\,$\to$\,1.27\%); fine-tuning resolves both (\S\ref{sec:composability}).
Post-hoc filtering achieves DR${=}$0\% but at 15--74\% rejection rates (Appendix~\ref{app:posthoc-extended}).

\paragraph{Cross-dataset validation on DocRED.}
\label{sec:docred-results}
DocRED (96 relations, 14$\times$ SciERC scale) validates the pattern under a larger, more restrictive ontology (Table~\ref{tab:docred-ablation}).
S1 reduces DR from 18.46\% to 10.21\% ($\downarrow$45\%), eliminates RV (29.66\%\,$\to$\,0.03\%) and ET, with R-F1 $+$0.50\,pp ($p < 0.001$).
The lower DR reduction (45\% vs.\ 94\% on SciERC) reflects DocRED's tighter constraints, which trigger more grammar-first fallback (\S\ref{sec:greedy-limitation}).
Grammar-only \emph{increases} DR (18.46\%\,$\to$\,26.17\%) via \textit{latent violation surfacing}: grammar forces OOV$\to$valid relation mapping, exposing type violations previously masked by vocabulary errors---a distinct cross-dataset confirmation of the scale-dependent layer interaction.
Fine-tuning reduces residual DR to $\leq$\,0.21\% (Table~\ref{tab:composability}; residual decomposition in Appendix~\ref{app:residual-dr-analysis}).

## 任务：代码匿名化检查（ARR 提交准备）

EMNLP 2026 ARR 提交要求匿名审稿。检查远程服务器上的项目代码目录，确认代码中没有作者姓名、机构名、邮箱等去匿名化信息。

### 服务器信息
- 服务器：westd-16980
- 项目代码目录：/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/

### 检查范围
用 ssh_read_only 在远程服务器上执行以下检查：

1. **搜索常见去匿名化模式**（在 /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ 下）：
   ```bash
   # 搜索邮箱地址
   grep -r '@[a-zA-Z]*\.\(edu\|com\|org\|de\|cn\)' --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.yaml' --include='*.json' --include='*.md' /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
   
   # 搜索 W&B 项目/entity 名（可能包含用户名）
   grep -r 'wandb\.\(entity\|project\)' --include='*.py' --include='*.yaml' /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
   
   # 搜索 WANDB_ENTITY 环境变量
   grep -r 'WANDB_ENTITY\|WANDB_PROJECT' --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.yaml' /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
   
   # 搜索 GitHub URL（可能包含用户名）
   grep -r 'github\.com/' --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.yaml' --include='*.md' /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
   
   # 搜索 author/name 字段
   grep -ri 'author\s*=' --include='*.py' --include='*.cfg' --include='*.toml' /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
   ```

2. **检查 README 和配置文件**：
   ```bash
   cat /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -30
   cat /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/setup.py 2>/dev/null | head -20
   cat /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | head -30
   ```

### 产出
输出一份简洁报告：
- 发现的去匿名化信息（文件路径 + 行内容）
- 是否需要修改（是/否）
- 如果需要修改，列出具体需要改的文件和行

注意：这是只读检查任务，不要修改任何文件。

Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files.
